nodes.title: CLIP Text Encode (Positive Prompt)
widgets_values:
Quadrant 1: Face Close-UpSubject Focus: High-resolution close-up of the character's face and upper chest.Features: A woman with a symmetrical face, sharp jawline, and warm undertones. She has expressive brown eyes, defined eyebrows, and soft, natural pink lips.Hair: Long, wavy, voluminous dark brown/black hair parted slightly off-center, cascading over her shoulders.Jewelry: Thin, delicate gold hoop earrings and a minimal fine-chain gold necklace with a small textured pendant resting on her collarbone.Quadrant 2: Full-Body Front & RearSubject Focus: Dual full-body views showing both the front and back angles of the character to ensure physical and structural consistency.Anatomy: An athletic, fit build with toned legs and a defined midriff.Front View: Showcases the character standing with a neutral, confident posture, displaying the fit of the grey tank top and denim shorts.Rear View: Displays the back of the outfit, her waist-length wavy hair, and how the shorts fit from behind.Footwear: White low-top sneakers paired with short white ankle socks.Quadrant 3: Clothes & Shoes AssetsSubject Focus: Isolated, flat-lay product renders of each individual item worn by the character for strict texture and color mapping.Top: A ribbed, heather grey scoop-neck sleeveless tank top with side-ruching textures.Bottom: Distressed, light-wash blue denim shorts featuring frayed hems and slight whiskering details.Shoes: Classic all-white leather low-top sneakers with a perforated toe box and thick rubber soles.Necklace: An isolated view of the delicate gold chain and its specific teardrop-shaped pendant.Quadrant 4: Background ReferenceSubject Focus: Clean plate environmental reference to guide the video model's lighting, depth of field, and context.Setting: An outdoor urban plaza or park setting during the daytime.Foreground: A smooth, light grey concrete or stone tiled pavement with soft, diffused shadows.Background: A low concrete retaining wall with lush green deciduous trees and a softly blurred, out-of-focus modern office building in the distance.

Target Description
The woman is dancing. she looks exactly like the reference photo. She follows the moves perfectly. At all time following body physics in her movements. Her feet are heavy due to gravity, not floating abnormally during the dance.

the camera remains cinematic and steady, capturing the full transition from preparation to boxing in one continuous shot. the aesthetic is realistic and documentary-like, with natural lighting, detailed facial texture, visible clothing texture, and grounded movement. the audio is immersive and minimal
